Author: Chris Beaven
Message:
refactor(mcp): convert tools to async-first architecture (Phase 2)

- Convert set_scene, play_sound, and transfer_to_agent to async functions
- Remove _HybridResult workaround pattern in favor of native async/await
- Add proper error handling for broadcast failures
- Update all 392 tests to await async tool functions
- Simplified async/sync boundaries per REFACTORING_PLAN.md section 1.4

Benefits:
- Proper async error handling instead of fire-and-forget
- Cleaner codebase without sync/async hybrid patterns
- Better control flow with explicit awaits
- Follows async-first architecture principle

All tests passing: 392 passed, 27 skipped
